## 1. AI 기반 인프라 이상 탐지

> 단순 임곗값 알람이 아니라 **패턴 학습 기반 Anomaly Detection**으로 장애를 사전에 예측하고, 근본 원인을 자동 분석하는 AIOps 체계를 구축한다.

### 1.1 CloudWatch Anomaly Detection 설정

```yaml
# cloudformation/anomaly-detection.yml
Resources:
  AnomalyDetectorErrorRate:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::AnomalyDetector
    Properties:
      MetricName: 5xxErrorRate
      Namespace: AWS/CloudFront
      Stat: Average

  AnomalyDetectorLatency:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::AnomalyDetector
    Properties:
      MetricName: OriginLatency
      Namespace: AWS/CloudFront
      Stat: p99

  ErrorRateAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: frontend-5xx-anomaly
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Metrics:
        - Id: error_rate
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              MetricName: 5xxErrorRate
              Namespace: AWS/CloudFront
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: anomaly_band
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(error_rate, 2)
      ThresholdMetricId: anomaly_band
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertSNSTopic

  LatencyAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: frontend-latency-anomaly
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Metrics:
        - Id: latency
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              MetricName: OriginLatency
              Namespace: AWS/CloudFront
            Period: 300
            Stat: p99
        - Id: anomaly_band
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(latency, 2)
      ThresholdMetricId: anomaly_band
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertSNSTopic
```

### 1.2 DevOps Guru 통합

```yaml
# cloudformation/devops-guru.yml
Resources:
  DevOpsGuruConfig:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsGuru::ResourceCollection
    Properties:
      ResourceCollectionFilter:
        CloudFormation:
          StackNames:
            - frontend-prod-stack
            - cdn-distribution-stack

  DevOpsGuruNotification:
    Type: AWS::DevOpsGuru::NotificationChannel
    Properties:
      Config:
        Sns:
          TopicArn: !Ref OpsAlertTopic
        Filters:
          Severities:
            - HIGH
            - MEDIUM
          MessageTypes:
            - NEW_INSIGHT
            - SEVERITY_UPGRADED
```

### 1.3 AIOps 통합 모니터링

```typescript
// ai-ops-monitor.ts
interface AIOpsConfig {
  anomalyDetection: {
    metrics: string[];
    sensitivityLevel: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
    trainingPeriodDays: number;
  };
  autoRemediation: {
    enabled: boolean;
    actions: RemediationAction[];
  };
  correlationEngine: {
    enabled: boolean;
    timeWindowMinutes: number;
  };
}

interface RemediationAction {
  trigger: string;
  action: 'scale-out' | 'cache-purge' | 'rollback' | 'failover' | 'notify';
  conditions: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface AnomalyEvent {
  metric: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  expected: { lower: number; upper: number };
  actual: number;
  severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'critical';
}

const aiOpsConfig: AIOpsConfig = {
  anomalyDetection: {
    metrics: [
      'CloudFront/5xxErrorRate',
      'CloudFront/OriginLatency',
      'CloudFront/CacheHitRate',
      'Lambda@Edge/Duration',
      'Lambda@Edge/Errors',
      'S3/4xxErrors',
    ],
    sensitivityLevel: 'medium',
    trainingPeriodDays: 14,
  },
  autoRemediation: {
    enabled: true,
    actions: [
      {
        trigger: 'CacheHitRate < anomaly_lower_bound',
        action: 'cache-purge',
        conditions: { duration: '5m', threshold: 0.7 },
      },
      {
        trigger: '5xxErrorRate > anomaly_upper_bound',
        action: 'rollback',
        conditions: { duration: '3m', severity: 'critical' },
      },
      {
        trigger: 'OriginLatency > anomaly_upper_bound',
        action: 'failover',
        conditions: { duration: '5m', failoverTarget: 'secondary-origin' },
      },
    ],
  },
  correlationEngine: {
    enabled: true,
    timeWindowMinutes: 15,
  },
};

async function analyzeAnomalyWithAI(
  events: AnomalyEvent[],
  recentDeployments: DeploymentRecord[],
  recentChanges: ChangeRecord[],
): Promise<RootCauseAnalysis> {
  const prompt = `
인프라 이상 징후를 분석하고 근본 원인을 추정하라.

## 감지된 이상 징후
${events.map((e) => `- ${e.metric}: 실제값 ${e.actual} (예상 범위: ${e.expected.lower}~${e.expected.upper}) [${e.severity}]`).join('\n')}

## 최근 배포 이력
${recentDeployments.map((d) => `- ${d.timestamp}: ${d.version} (${d.status})`).join('\n')}

## 최근 인프라 변경
${recentChanges.map((c) => `- ${c.timestamp}: ${c.description}`).join('\n')}

## 분석 요청
1. 이상 징후 간 상관관계 분석
2. 배포 또는 인프라 변경과의 연관성
3. 근본 원인 추정 (상위 3개)
4. 권장 조치 사항 (즉시 / 단기 / 장기)
`.trim();

  return await callAI<RootCauseAnalysis>(prompt);
}
```

### AI 프롬프트 예시

#### 프롬프트 1: 인프라 이상 탐지 분석

```
CloudWatch에서 아래 이상 징후가 동시에 감지되었다. 근본 원인을 분석해줘.

## 감지된 이상 징후 (최근 30분)
1. CloudFront 5xx 에러율: 평소 0.01% -> 2.3% (Anomaly Detection 상한 초과)
2. Origin Latency p99: 평소 120ms -> 890ms
3. Cache Hit Rate: 평소 92% -> 65%
4. Lambda@Edge Duration p99: 평소 15ms -> 200ms

## 최근 이벤트
- 25분 전: 프론트엔드 v3.12.1 배포 완료
- 20분 전: CloudFront 캐시 무효화 실행 (/assets/*)
- 10분 전: DevOps Guru에서 "Anomalous increase in Lambda@Edge errors" 인사이트 생성

## 요청
1. 이 4가지 이상 징후의 상관관계
2. 배포와 캐시 무효화가 원인인지 분석
3. Lambda@Edge 코드 문제 가능성
4. 즉시 조치 vs 모니터링 대기 판단 기준
5. 자동 롤백 트리거 조건 제안
```

#### 프롬프트 2: 자동 복구 전략 설계

```
프론트엔드 인프라의 자동 복구(Auto-Remediation) 전략을 설계해줘.

## 현재 인프라 구성
- CloudFront + S3 (주 배포)
- Lambda@Edge (A/B 테스트, 리다이렉트)
- Route 53 헬스체크 (DNS Failover)

## 자동 복구가 필요한 시나리오
1. 배포 직후 에러율 급증 -> 자동 롤백
2. 오리진 응답 지연 -> CDN 캐시 TTL 연장
3. Lambda@Edge 오류 -> 바이패스 모드 전환
4. 특정 리전 장애 -> Multi-CDN Failover

## 요청
1. 각 시나리오별 감지 조건 (CloudWatch 메트릭 + 임곗값)
2. 자동 복구 액션 (Lambda, Step Functions 활용)
3. 안전장치: 오탐지 방지, 복구 실패 시 에스컬레이션
4. TypeScript로 자동 복구 오케스트레이터 코드 작성
```

## 2. AI로 IaC 코드 자동 생성

> AI에게 인프라 요구사항을 자연어로 설명하면, CDK 또는 Pulumi 코드를 자동 생성할 수 있다. 생성 후 반드시 리뷰와 `diff` 확인을 거친다.

### 2.1 AI IaC 생성기

```typescript
// ai-iac-generator.ts
interface InfraRequirements {
  projectName: string;
  framework: 'cdk' | 'pulumi';
  resources: ResourceSpec[];
  region: string;
  multiRegion: boolean;
  budget: { monthly: number; currency: 'USD' };
}

interface ResourceSpec {
  type: 'static-site' | 'api' | 'database' | 'cdn' | 'edge-function' | 'monitoring';
  config: Record<string, unknown>;
}

async function generateIaCWithAI(
  requirements: InfraRequirements,
): Promise<GeneratedIaC> {
  const prompt = `
다음 요구사항에 맞는 ${requirements.framework.toUpperCase()} 코드를 TypeScript로 생성하라.

## 프로젝트: ${requirements.projectName}
## 리전: ${requirements.region} ${requirements.multiRegion ? '(멀티 리전)' : ''}
## 월 예산: $${requirements.budget.monthly}

## 필요 리소스
${requirements.resources.map((r) => `- ${r.type}: ${JSON.stringify(r.config)}`).join('\n')}

## 필수 준수 사항
1. 태깅 표준: Project, Environment, ManagedBy 태그 필수
2. 보안: 퍼블릭 접근 최소화, 암호화 기본 활성화
3. 비용: 예산 내 최적 인스턴스/서비스 선택
4. 모니터링: CloudWatch 알람 + Anomaly Detection 포함
5. IaC 모범 사례: 하드코딩 금지, 파라미터화

TypeScript 코드로 반환하라.
`.trim();

  return await callAI<GeneratedIaC>(prompt);
}
```

### 2.2 CDK v2 -- 정적 사이트 + CDN 스택

```typescript
// lib/static-site-stack.ts
import * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';
import * as s3 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3';
import * as cloudfront from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-cloudfront';
import * as origins from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-cloudfront-origins';
import * as acm from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-certificatemanager';
import * as route53 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-route53';
import * as targets from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-route53-targets';
import * as iam from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-iam';
import { Construct } from 'constructs';

interface StaticSiteStackProps extends cdk.StackProps {
  domainName: string;
  subdomain: string;
  environment: 'dev' | 'staging' | 'production';
}

export class StaticSiteStack extends cdk.Stack {
  public readonly distribution: cloudfront.Distribution;
  public readonly bucket: s3.Bucket;

  constructor(scope: Construct, id: string, props: StaticSiteStackProps) {
    super(scope, id, props);

    const siteDomain = `${props.subdomain}.${props.domainName}`;

    // S3 버킷 (퍼블릭 접근 차단)
    this.bucket = new s3.Bucket(this, 'SiteBucket', {
      bucketName: `${props.environment}-${siteDomain.replace(/\./g, '-')}`,
      blockPublicAccess: s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
      encryption: s3.BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED,
      versioned: props.environment === 'production',
      removalPolicy:
        props.environment === 'production'
          ? cdk.RemovalPolicy.RETAIN
          : cdk.RemovalPolicy.DESTROY,
      autoDeleteObjects: props.environment !== 'production',
    });

    // OAC (Origin Access Control)
    const oac = new cloudfront.CfnOriginAccessControl(this, 'OAC', {
      originAccessControlConfig: {
        name: `${id}-oac`,
        originAccessControlOriginType: 's3',
        signingBehavior: 'always',
        signingProtocol: 'sigv4',
      },
    });

    // ACM 인증서
    const hostedZone = route53.HostedZone.fromLookup(this, 'Zone', {
      domainName: props.domainName,
    });

    const certificate = new acm.Certificate(this, 'Certificate', {
      domainName: siteDomain,
      validation: acm.CertificateValidation.fromDns(hostedZone),
    });

    // CloudFront 배포
    this.distribution = new cloudfront.Distribution(this, 'Distribution', {
      defaultBehavior: {
        origin: origins.S3BucketOrigin.withOriginAccessControl(this.bucket),
        viewerProtocolPolicy: cloudfront.ViewerProtocolPolicy.REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS,
        cachePolicy: cloudfront.CachePolicy.CACHING_OPTIMIZED,
        responseHeadersPolicy:
          cloudfront.ResponseHeadersPolicy.CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS_WITH_PREFLIGHT_AND_SECURITY_HEADERS,
      },
      domainNames: [siteDomain],
      certificate,
      defaultRootObject: 'index.html',
      errorResponses: [
        {
          httpStatus: 404,
          responseHttpStatus: 200,
          responsePagePath: '/index.html',
          ttl: cdk.Duration.minutes(5),
        },
      ],
      priceClass: cloudfront.PriceClass.PRICE_CLASS_200,
    });

    // Route 53 레코드
    new route53.ARecord(this, 'AliasRecord', {
      zone: hostedZone,
      recordName: siteDomain,
      target: route53.RecordTarget.fromAlias(
        new targets.CloudFrontTarget(this.distribution),
      ),
    });

    // 태그
    cdk.Tags.of(this).add('Project', props.subdomain);
    cdk.Tags.of(this).add('Environment', props.environment);
    cdk.Tags.of(this).add('ManagedBy', 'CDK');
  }
}
```

### 2.3 Pulumi -- 동일 구성

```typescript
// infra/static-site.ts
import * as pulumi from '@pulumi/pulumi';
import * as aws from '@pulumi/aws';

interface StaticSiteArgs {
  domainName: string;
  subdomain: string;
  environment: 'dev' | 'staging' | 'production';
}

export class StaticSite extends pulumi.ComponentResource {
  public readonly bucketName: pulumi.Output<string>;
  public readonly distributionId: pulumi.Output<string>;
  public readonly siteUrl: pulumi.Output<string>;

  constructor(name: string, args: StaticSiteArgs, opts?: pulumi.ComponentResourceOptions) {
    super('custom:StaticSite', name, {}, opts);

    const siteDomain = `${args.subdomain}.${args.domainName}`;

    const bucket = new aws.s3.BucketV2(`${name}-bucket`, {
      bucket: `${args.environment}-${siteDomain.replace(/\./g, '-')}`,
      tags: {
        Project: args.subdomain,
        Environment: args.environment,
        ManagedBy: 'Pulumi',
      },
    }, { parent: this });

    new aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock(`${name}-public-access`, {
      bucket: bucket.id,
      blockPublicAcls: true,
      blockPublicPolicy: true,
      ignorePublicAcls: true,
      restrictPublicBuckets: true,
    }, { parent: this });

    const oac = new aws.cloudfront.OriginAccessControl(`${name}-oac`, {
      name: `${name}-oac`,
      originAccessControlOriginType: 's3',
      signingBehavior: 'always',
      signingProtocol: 'sigv4',
    }, { parent: this });

    const zone = aws.route53.getZoneOutput({ name: args.domainName });

    const cert = new aws.acm.Certificate(`${name}-cert`, {
      domainName: siteDomain,
      validationMethod: 'DNS',
    }, { parent: this, provider: new aws.Provider(`${name}-us-east-1`, { region: 'us-east-1' }) });

    const distribution = new aws.cloudfront.Distribution(`${name}-cdn`, {
      enabled: true,
      defaultRootObject: 'index.html',
      aliases: [siteDomain],
      origins: [{
        domainName: bucket.bucketRegionalDomainName,
        originId: 's3Origin',
        originAccessControlId: oac.id,
      }],
      defaultCacheBehavior: {
        targetOriginId: 's3Origin',
        viewerProtocolPolicy: 'redirect-to-https',
        allowedMethods: ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'],
        cachedMethods: ['GET', 'HEAD'],
        cachePolicyId: '658327ea-f89d-4fab-a63d-7e88639e58f6', // CachingOptimized
        compress: true,
      },
      customErrorResponses: [{
        errorCode: 404,
        responseCode: 200,
        responsePagePath: '/index.html',
        errorCachingMinTtl: 300,
      }],
      restrictions: { geoRestriction: { restrictionType: 'none' } },
      viewerCertificate: {
        acmCertificateArn: cert.arn,
        sslSupportMethod: 'sni-only',
        minimumProtocolVersion: 'TLSv1.2_2021',
      },
      priceClass: 'PriceClass_200',
      tags: {
        Project: args.subdomain,
        Environment: args.environment,
        ManagedBy: 'Pulumi',
      },
    }, { parent: this });

    new aws.route53.Record(`${name}-dns`, {
      zoneId: zone.zoneId,
      name: siteDomain,
      type: 'A',
      aliases: [{
        name: distribution.domainName,
        zoneId: distribution.hostedZoneId,
        evaluateTargetHealth: false,
      }],
    }, { parent: this });

    this.bucketName = bucket.bucket;
    this.distributionId = distribution.id;
    this.siteUrl = pulumi.interpolate`https://${siteDomain}`;

    this.registerOutputs({
      bucketName: this.bucketName,
      distributionId: this.distributionId,
      siteUrl: this.siteUrl,
    });
  }
}
```

## 3. AI 기반 비용 최적화 분석

> AI에게 AWS 비용 데이터를 제공하면, 과다 지출 항목 식별, 리소스 적정화, 아키텍처 개선 방안을 자동으로 분석할 수 있다.

### 3.1 AI 비용 분석기

```typescript
// ai-cost-analyzer.ts
interface CostAnalysisResult {
  totalMonthlyCost: number;
  topExpenses: CostBreakdown[];
  optimizations: CostOptimization[];
  estimatedSavings: number;
  architectureRecommendations: string[];
}

interface CostOptimization {
  resource: string;
  currentCost: number;
  optimizedCost: number;
  savings: number;
  action: string;
  risk: 'none' | 'low' | 'medium';
  effort: 'trivial' | 'small' | 'medium';
}

async function analyzeCostsWithAI(
  costData: AWSCostData,
  usageMetrics: UsageMetrics,
): Promise<CostAnalysisResult> {
  const prompt = `
AWS 프론트엔드 인프라 비용을 분석하고 최적화 방안을 제안하라.

## 월간 비용 (최근 3개월 평균)
${costData.services.map((s) => `- ${s.name}: $${s.monthlyCost} (${s.trend})`).join('\n')}
- 합계: $${costData.total}/월

## 리소스 사용률
- CloudFront: ${usageMetrics.cdn.requestsPerMonth}M req/월, 캐시 히트율 ${usageMetrics.cdn.cacheHitRate}%
- S3: ${usageMetrics.s3.storageSizeGB}GB, ${usageMetrics.s3.requestsPerMonth}K req/월
- Lambda@Edge: ${usageMetrics.lambda.invocationsPerMonth}M 호출/월, 평균 ${usageMetrics.lambda.avgDurationMs}ms
- CloudWatch: ${usageMetrics.monitoring.metricsCount}개 메트릭, ${usageMetrics.monitoring.logsGB}GB 로그/월

## 분석 요청
1. 과다 지출 항목 식별
2. 즉시 적용 가능한 비용 절감 (리스크 없음)
3. 아키텍처 변경을 통한 비용 절감
4. 각 최적화별 예상 절감액과 구현 난이도
5. 비용 알람 임곗값 제안
`.trim();

  return await callAI<CostAnalysisResult>(prompt);
}
```

### 3.2 자동 비용 모니터링

```typescript
// cost-monitor.ts
import { CostExplorerClient, GetCostAndUsageCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-cost-explorer';
import { BudgetsClient, CreateBudgetCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-budgets';

async function setupCostAlerts(
  accountId: string,
  monthlyBudget: number,
): Promise<void> {
  const budgets = new BudgetsClient({});

  await budgets.send(
    new CreateBudgetCommand({
      AccountId: accountId,
      Budget: {
        BudgetName: 'frontend-infra-monthly',
        BudgetType: 'COST',
        TimeUnit: 'MONTHLY',
        BudgetLimit: {
          Amount: String(monthlyBudget),
          Unit: 'USD',
        },
      },
      NotificationsWithSubscribers: [
        {
          Notification: {
            NotificationType: 'ACTUAL',
            ComparisonOperator: 'GREATER_THAN',
            Threshold: 80,
            ThresholdType: 'PERCENTAGE',
          },
          Subscribers: [
            { SubscriptionType: 'EMAIL', Address: 'ops@example.com' },
            { SubscriptionType: 'SNS', Address: 'arn:aws:sns:ap-northeast-2:123456789:cost-alerts' },
          ],
        },
        {
          Notification: {
            NotificationType: 'FORECASTED',
            ComparisonOperator: 'GREATER_THAN',
            Threshold: 100,
            ThresholdType: 'PERCENTAGE',
          },
          Subscribers: [
            { SubscriptionType: 'EMAIL', Address: 'ops@example.com' },
          ],
        },
      ],
    }),
  );
}

async function getCostReport(days: number = 30): Promise<CostReport> {
  const client = new CostExplorerClient({});
  const end = new Date();
  const start = new Date(end.getTime() - days * 86400000);

  const response = await client.send(
    new GetCostAndUsageCommand({
      TimePeriod: {
        Start: start.toISOString().split('T')[0],
        End: end.toISOString().split('T')[0],
      },
      Granularity: 'DAILY',
      Metrics: ['UnblendedCost', 'UsageQuantity'],
      GroupBy: [{ Type: 'DIMENSION', Key: 'SERVICE' }],
      Filter: {
        Tags: { Key: 'Project', Values: ['frontend'], MatchOptions: ['EQUALS'] },
      },
    }),
  );

  return parseCostResponse(response);
}
```

### 4.2 모노레포 선별 배포

```typescript
// selective-deploy.ts
interface PackageDeployConfig {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  deployTarget: string;
  dependencies: string[]; // shared 패키지 의존성
}

const packages: PackageDeployConfig[] = [
  {
    name: 'web',
    path: 'packages/web',
    deployTarget: 's3://prod-web-bucket',
    dependencies: ['packages/shared', 'packages/ui'],
  },
  {
    name: 'admin',
    path: 'packages/admin',
    deployTarget: 's3://prod-admin-bucket',
    dependencies: ['packages/shared'],
  },
  {
    name: 'docs',
    path: 'packages/docs',
    deployTarget: 's3://prod-docs-bucket',
    dependencies: [],
  },
];

function detectAffectedPackages(
  changedFiles: string[],
  packages: PackageDeployConfig[],
): PackageDeployConfig[] {
  return packages.filter((pkg) =>
    changedFiles.some(
      (file) =>
        file.startsWith(pkg.path) ||
        pkg.dependencies.some((dep) => file.startsWith(dep)),
    ),
  );
}
```

### 4.3 Feature Flag 기반 배포

```typescript
// feature-flag-deploy.ts
interface FeatureFlag {
  key: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  rolloutPercentage: number;
  targetRules: TargetRule[];
  fallback: boolean;
}

interface TargetRule {
  attribute: string;
  operator: 'eq' | 'in' | 'contains' | 'regex';
  values: string[];
  enabled: boolean;
}

class FeatureFlagClient {
  private flags: Map<string, FeatureFlag> = new Map();
  private refreshIntervalMs: number;

  constructor(private endpoint: string, refreshIntervalMs: number = 30000) {
    this.refreshIntervalMs = refreshIntervalMs;
    this.startPolling();
  }

  isEnabled(flagKey: string, context?: UserContext): boolean {
    const flag = this.flags.get(flagKey);
    if (!flag) return false;
    if (!flag.enabled) return flag.fallback;

    // 타겟 룰 매칭
    if (context && flag.targetRules.length > 0) {
      const matched = flag.targetRules.some((rule) =>
        this.evaluateRule(rule, context),
      );
      if (matched) return true;
    }

    // 점진적 롤아웃
    if (context?.userId) {
      const hash = this.hashUserId(context.userId, flagKey);
      return hash < flag.rolloutPercentage;
    }

    return flag.fallback;
  }

  private hashUserId(userId: string, flagKey: string): number {
    let hash = 0;
    const str = `${userId}:${flagKey}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
      hash = (hash * 31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) % 100;
    }
    return Math.abs(hash);
  }

  private evaluateRule(rule: TargetRule, context: UserContext): boolean {
    const value = context[rule.attribute as keyof UserContext] as string;
    if (!value) return false;

    switch (rule.operator) {
      case 'eq': return rule.values.includes(value);
      case 'in': return rule.values.includes(value);
      case 'contains': return rule.values.some((v) => value.includes(v));
      case 'regex': return rule.values.some((v) => new RegExp(v).test(value));
      default: return false;
    }
  }

  private startPolling(): void {
    setInterval(() => this.refresh(), this.refreshIntervalMs);
    this.refresh();
  }

  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const response = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/flags`);
    const flags: FeatureFlag[] = await response.json();
    this.flags = new Map(flags.map((f) => [f.key, f]));
  }
}
```

### 4.4 런타임 설정 주입

```typescript
// runtime-config.ts
interface RuntimeConfig {
  apiUrl: string;
  environment: string;
  featureFlagsEndpoint: string;
  sentryDsn: string;
  analyticsId: string;
}

// 빌드 타임이 아닌 런타임에 설정을 주입하여 "Build Once, Deploy Everywhere" 구현
function loadRuntimeConfig(): RuntimeConfig {
  // 1순위: window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__ (배포 시 주입된 config.js)
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__) {
    return window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__ as RuntimeConfig;
  }

  // 2순위: 환경 변수 (SSR, 로컬 개발)
  return {
    apiUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000/api',
    environment: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENV ?? 'development',
    featureFlagsEndpoint: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_FF_ENDPOINT ?? '',
    sentryDsn: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN ?? '',
    analyticsId: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID ?? '',
  };
}

// config.js 생성 스크립트 (CI/CD에서 배포 직전 실행)
function generateConfigScript(env: Record<string, string>): string {
  return `window.__RUNTIME_CONFIG__ = ${JSON.stringify({
    apiUrl: env.API_URL,
    environment: env.ENV,
    featureFlagsEndpoint: env.FF_ENDPOINT,
    sentryDsn: env.SENTRY_DSN,
    analyticsId: env.ANALYTICS_ID,
  }, null, 2)};`;
}
```

## 5. Edge Computing 2026

### 5.1 CloudFront Functions vs Lambda@Edge

```
CloudFront Functions (뷰어 요청/응답)
├── 실행 시간: < 1ms
├── 메모리: 2MB
├── 네트워크 접근: 불가
├── 용도: URL 리라이트, 헤더 조작, 리다이렉트, A/B 라우팅
└── 비용: $0.10 / 1M 호출

Lambda@Edge (오리진 요청/응답)
├── 실행 시간: < 30초
├── 메모리: 최대 10GB
├── 네트워크 접근: 가능
├── 용도: SSR, 이미지 최적화, 인증, API 프록시
└── 비용: $0.60 / 1M 호출 + 컴퓨팅 시간
```

### 5.2 A/B 테스트 라우팅 (CloudFront Functions)

```typescript
// cloudfront-functions/ab-routing.ts
// CloudFront Functions (ES 5.1 호환)
function handler(event: AWSCloudFrontFunction.Event): AWSCloudFrontFunction.Response {
  var request = event.request;
  var headers = request.headers;
  var cookies = request.cookies;

  // 기존 A/B 쿠키 확인
  var abGroup = cookies['x-ab-group'] ? cookies['x-ab-group'].value : null;

  if (!abGroup) {
    // 새 사용자: 랜덤 배정
    abGroup = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'control' : 'experiment';
  }

  // 실험군은 /experiment/ 프리픽스 경로로 라우팅
  if (abGroup === 'experiment' && !request.uri.startsWith('/experiment/')) {
    request.uri = '/experiment' + request.uri;
  }

  // A/B 그룹 쿠키 설정
  request.headers['x-ab-group'] = { value: abGroup };

  return request;
}
```

### 5.3 Edge SSR (Lambda@Edge)

```typescript
// lambda-edge/ssr-handler.ts
import { CloudFrontRequestEvent, CloudFrontResponseResult } from 'aws-lambda';

export async function handler(
  event: CloudFrontRequestEvent,
): Promise<CloudFrontResponseResult> {
  const request = event.Records[0].cf.request;
  const uri = request.uri;

  // 정적 자산은 S3로 통과
  if (uri.match(/\.(js|css|png|jpg|svg|ico|woff2?)$/)) {
    return request;
  }

  // 동적 페이지는 Edge에서 SSR
  try {
    const html = await renderPage(uri, request.headers);

    return {
      status: '200',
      statusDescription: 'OK',
      headers: {
        'content-type': [{ value: 'text/html; charset=utf-8' }],
        'cache-control': [{ value: 'public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300' }],
        'x-rendered-at': [{ value: 'edge' }],
      },
      body: html,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    // SSR 실패 시 CSR 폴백
    return request;
  }
}

async function renderPage(
  uri: string,
  headers: Record<string, Array<{ value: string }>>,
): Promise<string> {
  // React/Next.js SSR 렌더링 로직
  const userAgent = headers['user-agent']?.[0]?.value ?? '';
  const isBot = /googlebot|bingbot|yandex/i.test(userAgent);

  // 봇에게는 전체 SSR, 일반 사용자에게는 Shell + Streaming
  if (isBot) {
    return await fullSSR(uri);
  }
  return await streamingSSR(uri);
}
```

## 6. Source Map 보안 관리

> 프로덕션 Source Map은 코드 구조를 노출하므로, **절대 퍼블릭 CDN에 배포하지 않는다**. 별도 보안 버킷에 저장하고 Sentry 등 에러 추적 도구만 접근 가능하게 한다.

### 6.1 Source Map 분리 배포

```yaml
# .github/workflows/sourcemap-secure.yml
name: Secure Source Map Deploy

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      environment:
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  deploy-sourcemaps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Build with source maps
        run: pnpm build
        env:
          GENERATE_SOURCEMAP: 'true'

      - name: Upload source maps to Sentry
        run: |
          npx @sentry/cli sourcemaps upload \
            --release=${{ github.sha }} \
            --url-prefix='~/' \
            dist/

      - name: Upload source maps to secure bucket
        run: |
          aws s3 sync dist/ s3://${{ vars.SOURCEMAP_BUCKET }}/${{ github.sha }}/ \
            --include "*.map" \
            --exclude "*" \
            --sse AES256

      - name: Remove source maps from deploy artifact
        run: find dist -name '*.map' -delete

      - name: Remove sourceMappingURL references
        run: |
          find dist -name '*.js' -exec \
            sed -i 's|//# sourceMappingURL=.*||g' {} +
```

### 6.2 Source Map 접근 제어

```typescript
// secure-sourcemap-access.ts
import * as cdk from 'aws-cdk-lib';
import * as s3 from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-s3';
import * as iam from 'aws-cdk-lib/aws-iam';

export class SourceMapBucketStack extends cdk.Stack {
  constructor(scope: cdk.App, id: string) {
    super(scope, id);

    const bucket = new s3.Bucket(this, 'SourceMapBucket', {
      bucketName: 'secure-sourcemaps',
      blockPublicAccess: s3.BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL,
      encryption: s3.BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED,
      lifecycleRules: [
        { expiration: cdk.Duration.days(90) }, // 90일 후 자동 삭제
      ],
      versioned: false,
    });

    // Sentry 서버만 접근 가능
    bucket.addToResourcePolicy(
      new iam.PolicyStatement({
        effect: iam.Effect.ALLOW,
        principals: [new iam.ArnPrincipal('arn:aws:iam::SENTRY_ACCOUNT:role/sentry-sourcemap-reader')],
        actions: ['s3:GetObject'],
        resources: [bucket.arnForObjects('*')],
      }),
    );
  }
}
```

## 7. CDN 캐시 워밍 및 전략

### 7.1 배포 후 캐시 워밍

```typescript
// cdn-cache-warmer.ts
interface CacheWarmConfig {
  distributionDomain: string;
  criticalPaths: string[];
  edgeLocations: string[];
  concurrency: number;
}

async function warmCDNCache(config: CacheWarmConfig): Promise<WarmResult[]> {
  const results: WarmResult[] = [];

  // 핵심 페이지를 각 엣지 로케이션에서 요청하여 캐시 채움
  const tasks = config.criticalPaths.flatMap((path) =>
    config.edgeLocations.map((region) => ({
      url: `https://${config.distributionDomain}${path}`,
      region,
    })),
  );

  // 동시성 제한 실행
  const chunks = chunkArray(tasks, config.concurrency);
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    const chunkResults = await Promise.allSettled(
      chunk.map(async (task) => {
        const start = performance.now();
        const response = await fetch(task.url, {
          headers: { 'X-Cache-Warm': 'true' },
        });
        const duration = performance.now() - start;

        return {
          url: task.url,
          region: task.region,
          status: response.status,
          cacheStatus: response.headers.get('x-cache') ?? 'unknown',
          durationMs: Math.round(duration),
        };
      }),
    );

    results.push(
      ...chunkResults
        .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<WarmResult> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
        .map((r) => r.value),
    );
  }

  return results;
}

const warmConfig: CacheWarmConfig = {
  distributionDomain: 'dxxx.cloudfront.net',
  criticalPaths: [
    '/',
    '/login',
    '/dashboard',
    '/assets/main.js',
    '/assets/main.css',
    '/assets/vendor.js',
  ],
  edgeLocations: [
    'ap-northeast-2', // 서울
    'ap-northeast-1', // 도쿄
    'us-east-1',      // 버지니아
  ],
  concurrency: 10,
};
```
